intake.domain: quantitative chest CT — through-plane restoration of thick-slice (5-8 mm) chest CT for emphysema densitometry (LAA-950, Perc15)
intake.venue: MICCAI / IEEE TMI / Medical Image Analysis (methods venue with a clinical-quantification audience)
data: RPLHR-CT (public, CC-BY-4.0, 250 chest CT cases with REAL paired 1 mm / 5 mm reconstructions of the same acquisition; 100 train / 50 val / 100 test)
LIDC-IDRI / LUNA16 thin-slice chest CT (public, scalable pre-training pool)
private multi-centre thick-slice cohorts (5 mm and 8 mm) with real thin/thick pairs, available in a later stage
intake.compute: 1x RTX 5080 16 GB (single workstation); a full training run of the current 0.35 M-parameter 3D model is 20-40 min, so a campaign of ~50 runs plus evaluation is ~2 GPU-weeks
intake.expertise: medical image reconstruction + quantitative CT; full control of the training/eval stack; access to real paired data and to radiology collaborators
intake.baseline: trilinear up-sampling of the thick series; through-plane super-resolution networks (openalex:W4404646478, dblp:journals/corr/abs-2206-06253, dblp:conf/cvpr/PengLLCZ20); post-hoc densitometry harmonisation (openalex:W4407122143, semanticscholar:d74be52ba0f218a2a036eae2a46bdc1142db0cf6)
intake.limitation: a single-pass restoration trained with a densitometric guardrail recovers LAA-950 on SIMULATED thick slabs (CCC 0.875) but only marginally on the scanner's REAL thick series (CCC 0.472); fine-tuning on real pairs restores CCC to 0.840, yet a tensor-level diff shows the entire benefit is reproduced by changing ONE scalar - the output bias, by -12.2 HU - while the reconstructed lung histogram stays too narrow (54.9 HU vs 58.6 HU reference)

bottleneck_statement: Thick-slice chest CT restoration is optimised and judged as an IMAGE, while the quantity it is used for is a THRESHOLD STATISTIC OF THE VOXEL HISTOGRAM (percent of lung voxels below -950 HU; the 15th percentile of lung attenuation). This is a structural property of any restoration whose training signal is a per-voxel or perceptual distance: the map from reconstruction to threshold statistic is many-to-one, so a global shift of the attenuation histogram and a genuine recovery of its low-attenuation tail are indistinguishable to the objective, to the metric, and to the reader — the primary instance being the thick-to-thin chest CT line, where the anchor multi-centre system (openalex:W4404646478) validates on diagnostic accuracy, its own real-paired benchmark (dblp:journals/corr/abs-2206-06253) reports PSNR/SSIM only, and the closest through-plane neighbours (semanticscholar:b09c6588b37ff104bf84a6a1ed1e0fe895eeed43, arxiv:2607.16649v1) report image quality and, at most, a noise-power spectrum as a descriptive side analysis. The densitometry side of the field never closes the loop either, because it corrects the SCALAR after the fact and leaves the image alone: kernel harmonisation (openalex:W4407122143) converts reconstruction kernels but not slice thickness, and simultaneous volume/noise/scanner-bias correction (semanticscholar:d74be52ba0f218a2a036eae2a46bdc1142db0cf6) regresses out confounders of a summary number without ever producing a volume whose histogram is defensible. The failure is therefore not that restoration is inaccurate but that NOTHING IN EITHER LINE CAN CERTIFY WHY A THRESHOLD STATISTIC CAME OUT RIGHT, and on real scanner output — where the assumed slice-sensitivity/noise model is wrong by a measurable residual (arxiv:2603.04538v1 shows how large such operator mismatch is in deployed systems) — the two explanations diverge and only the wrong one is cheap to obtain.

closest_adjacent.summary_and_residue: Trains a convolution-transformer hybrid to synthesise 1 mm chest CT from 5 mm input and validates it multi-centre on DIAGNOSTIC endpoints (reader study plus downstream AI products), establishing that thick-slice enhancement changes clinical decisions. Its residue is that the degradation is a single fixed learned thick-to-thin mapping with no per-scan identification of the slice-sensitivity profile or noise level, and no densitometric endpoint anywhere in training or evaluation — the paper never mentions LAA-950, Perc15 or lung-density distribution, so a reconstruction that shifts the attenuation histogram and one that restores its tail are equally acceptable to its objective and to its validation.

Publishes the only public REAL-paired 1 mm/5 mm chest CT benchmark and shows that models trained on pseudo-paired (simulated) degradation transfer poorly to real low-resolution volumes, then supplies a transformer baseline. Its residue is that the real-vs-pseudo gap is DEMONSTRATED and measured in PSNR/SSIM only — the benchmark carries no quantitative-biomarker endpoint, so the gap cannot be attributed to a physical cause and no mechanism is offered to close it per scan.

Builds the first cross-modality benchmark for OPERATOR MISMATCH, showing state-of-the-art reconstruction networks lose >20 dB when the assumed forward operator deviates from the physical one in a handful of parameters. Its residue is that it characterises and benchmarks mismatch but supplies no per-scan identification loop that feeds the estimate back into reconstruction, and no clinical measurement whose bias the estimated mismatch has to explain.

Solves blind inverse problems by jointly inferring the image and the measurement operator under a generative prior over operators. Its residue is a single monolithic optimisation in which operator error and prior error are not separable: nothing localises a residual disagreement to the physics rather than to the image estimate, and no downstream quantity constrains the solution, so the joint estimate can absorb a systematic bias silently.

Argues that in safety-sensitive settings a restoration model is not free to rewrite its input, and constrains the magnitude, location and stability of its own edits (residual-bounded CT/CTA enhancement). Its residue is that the bound is stated in the IMAGE domain — how much a voxel may change — which neither implies nor certifies a bound on a downstream measurement: a small, spatially diffuse, perfectly admissible edit is exactly what moves a -950 HU threshold count.

Converts reconstruction kernels across hospitals and shows the emphysema extent then correlates better with clinical parameters, i.e. harmonisation of the acquisition into one reference setting rescues the biomarker. Its residue is that the conversion is one global mapping fitted per kernel pair, leaves slice thickness — the dominant through-plane confounder — untouched, and offers no per-scan estimate of how far the current series is from the reference.

Couples Bayesian spectral deconvolution with an expert-reasoning (LLM) loop that revises the physical model when automated deconvolution fails on unknown background/noise — the closest existing instance of 'a reasoner and a physics solver working on the same inverse problem'. Its residue is that the reasoning loop revises a 1-D physical model with no data-consistency contract binding its proposals and no quantitative endpoint it must defend, so nothing decides the case where the reasoner and the measurement disagree.

An MLLM-driven restoration agent that selects tools and their application order for coupled degradations, learning from its own past trajectories instead of planning zero-shot. Its residue is that agency operates at the level of TOOL SELECTION over a natural-image restoration toolbox: no agent owns a physical measurement model, no shared observation constrains the agents, and no quantity of record has to survive the plan.

what_phase_0_did_not_address: No retrieved frontier leaf can establish WHY its reconstruction's threshold statistic is correct — i.e. none separates 'the low-attenuation tail of the lung histogram was recovered' from 'the histogram was displaced until the threshold count matched', and none reports a quantity that would distinguish them on a scan whose reference is unavailable — stakes: this is exactly the failure we measured on real scanner output, where the entire apparent gain of real-pair fine-tuning was reproduced by a single -12.2 HU output-bias change while the reconstructed histogram stayed too narrow (54.9 vs 58.6 HU); a centre that adopts such a model gets an emphysema index that is right on the validation cohort and drifts arbitrarily on the next scanner, and intellectually every published thick-slice-restoration densitometry result is uninterpretable because the two explanations were never separated.

No retrieved leaf tests whether the through-plane acquisition operator has to be treated as KNOWN (or as one globally learned mapping) at all — every restoration leaf inherits that assumption from the shared interpolation/deconvolution ancestor, and the model-based leaves that do relax it (arxiv:2503.21501v1, arxiv:2403.04847v2, semanticscholar:0d3795c98a2a83d53704e5965e08461bc452dfc1) recover physical parameters for their own sake, without asking what a per-scan estimate would have to be accountable to — stakes: practitioners inherit a model whose degradation assumption is unfalsifiable at inference time, so a scanner whose true slice profile or noise texture sits outside the training distribution fails silently rather than loudly; intellectually, the field cannot report an operator estimate as evidence, which is why the same restoration paper can be published for 5 mm and re-published for 8 mm with no cumulative knowledge about the operator itself.

No retrieved leaf produces, per scan and without a reference, an adjudicated verdict about its own output — the model-based line ends at a residual norm, the agentic line (arxiv:2605.22208v2, arxiv:2606.29763v1) ends at a plan, and neither converts a disagreement between the physics it assumed and the observation it was given into an actionable statement about the number a clinician will read — stakes: in a multi-centre trial the practical question is not 'is the image nicer' but 'may I pool this scan's emphysema index with the others', and today that question is answered by protocol paperwork rather than by the reconstruction; without it, restoration cannot enter a densitometry endpoint pipeline at all, whatever its PSNR.

method_lineage.line: through-plane restoration of anisotropic chest CT, and the quantitative densitometry it is supposed to serve

nodes.method: trilinear / spline interpolation of the thick series onto a 1 mm grid
nodes.move: root: resample without any model of how the thick slice was formed
nodes.residual_problem: cannot restore through-plane frequency content that slab averaging removed; systematically narrows the attenuation histogram and biases every threshold statistic computed from it

nodes.method: classical through-plane deconvolution with a measured slice-sensitivity profile (Richardson-Lucy / Wiener)
nodes.move: introduce an explicit acquisition operator and invert it
nodes.residual_problem: the SSP must be measured on a phantom (semanticscholar:02f48e3fa041a99ffb7c44b0431e98cb818919d5-style tilted-wire protocols), is unavailable for an archived patient series, and inversion amplifies noise

nodes.move: replace the analytic inverse with a learned prior trained on simulated thick-from-thin pairs
nodes.residual_problem: trained on pseudo-paired degradation and optimised for image fidelity; nothing ties the output to a measurement

nodes.method: transformer volumetric SR on a REAL-paired benchmark (RPLHR-CT / TVSRN)
nodes.move: expose the pseudo-vs-real domain gap by building real 1 mm/5 mm pairs, and drop convolution for attention
nodes.residual_problem: the real-vs-simulated gap is measured in PSNR/SSIM and left open; no physical cause is attributed and no quantitative endpoint is defined

nodes.method: multi-centre deep thick-slice enhancement validated on diagnosis (CTHNet)
nodes.move: prove clinical value of the restored volume by reader study and downstream AI performance
nodes.residual_problem: diagnosis-level validation says nothing about the voxel histogram; the degradation stays a fixed learned mapping, so densitometric endpoints are neither trained for nor certified

nodes.method: generative / flow-based through-plane super-resolution (DRIFT; reference-and-memory-guided cardiac SR)
nodes.move: replace the regressor with a sampler to escape over-smoothing at large slice thickness
nodes.residual_problem: samples plausible texture with no constraint that its statistics match the reference distribution, which is precisely what a threshold statistic reads

nodes.method: deep slice interpolation reporting a noise-power spectrum alongside image metrics (head CT)
nodes.move: add a frequency-domain description of what the restoration did to noise
nodes.residual_problem: the NPS is a descriptive side analysis, not a constraint the reconstruction must satisfy, and it is never connected to a threshold statistic

nodes.method: unrolled reconstruction with an exactly known operator and data-consistency steps
nodes.move: put the physics inside the network and alternate prior with consistency
nodes.residual_problem: assumes the operator is exact; consistency is enforced against a model that may itself be wrong

nodes.method: absorbing model mismatch with an untrained per-instance correction inside a model-based architecture
nodes.move: stop assuming the operator is exact; let a per-instance network soak up the discrepancy
nodes.residual_problem: the mismatch is absorbed but never IDENTIFIED as an interpretable physical quantity, so it cannot be reported, audited, or compared across scans

nodes.method: double-blind joint image + operator inference with a generative operator prior
nodes.move: give the unknown operator its own prior and infer both together
nodes.residual_problem: one monolithic objective: operator error and image-prior error are not separable, and no downstream quantity constrains the joint solution

nodes.method: joint reconstruction and acquisition-geometry calibration with a differentiable ray model
nodes.move: make the acquisition parameters differentiable and fit them per scan
nodes.residual_problem: calibrates geometry only; slice sensitivity, noise texture and reconstruction kernel are outside the parameterisation, and no clinical measurement is defended

nodes.move: constrain how much, where and how stably the model may edit its input
nodes.residual_problem: the bound lives in the image domain; a diffuse admissible edit still moves a threshold statistic, so nothing is guaranteed about the number that is read off

nodes.method: MLLM restoration agents that select tools and orders from experience (EvoIR-Agent); agentic pipeline configuration in medical imaging (TopoAgent)
nodes.move: put a reasoning agent in charge of composing the restoration pipeline
nodes.residual_problem: agency is spent on tool/pipeline choice; no agent owns a physical measurement model, nothing binds proposals to the observation, and no quantity of record must survive the plan

nodes.move: attack the same biased-emphysema-index residual by converting acquisitions to one reference kernel instead of restoring the volume
nodes.residual_problem: kernel only, slice thickness untouched; one global mapping with no per-scan estimate of distance from the reference

nodes.method: statistical correction of the density summary for volume, noise and inter-scanner bias
nodes.move: attack the same residual by regressing confounders out of the scalar readout
nodes.residual_problem: operates on the summary number, never produces a defensible volume, and slice thickness is not among the corrected confounders

nodes.method: protocol standardisation and phantom QA for trial densitometry (Fleischner position)
nodes.move: attack the same residual administratively — fix acquisition and calibration by protocol
nodes.residual_problem: cannot rescue the archived thick-slice scans that already exist, which is the population the whole restoration line targets

nodes.method: phantom measurement of the slice sensitivity profile (micro-coin, tilted wire)
nodes.move: attack the operator-unknown residual by measuring the SSP directly on hardware
nodes.residual_problem: requires a dedicated phantom scan on the same scanner/protocol; nothing recovers the SSP of an archived patient series

method_lineage.notes: (1) PROVENANCE: n2-n16 are retrieved and citable; n0-n1 are parametric awareness-only ancestors (classical interpolation and phantom-SSP deconvolution) reconstructed to make regression visible — a 'cure' that amounts to deconvolving with a nominal SSP lands on n1 and is a regression, not a contribution. (2) The subtractive reading is taken from the ancestry chain n0->n1->n2->n3: every restoration leaf (n4, n5, n6) inherits the assumption that the through-plane operator is fixed and given, either analytically (n1) or implicitly by the training pairs (n2, n3). (3) COLLATERAL: n12-n16 attack the same residuals through different mechanisms (agentic pipeline control, statistical harmonisation, administrative standardisation, hardware measurement) and exist here so that a candidate cure landing on any of them is recognised as an existing node — in particular, 'harmonise to a reference kernel/protocol' (n13/n15) and 'measure the SSP on a phantom' (n16) are occupied ground. (4) The lineage is deep on the classical side and shallow on the agentic side, which is honest: agent-based imaging is genuinely young.

domain_pattern_distribution.notes: The area is dominated by controlled_diagnostic_design (papers that MEASURE how acquisition parameters bias a quantitative readout) and architectural_operator_substitution (papers that swap the restoration backbone); the shared limitation of the closest_adjacent papers is that the diagnostic line stops at documenting the bias while the architectural line optimises an image-fidelity objective, so no retrieved paper closes the loop between the two.
